faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about QR codes and QRcodly.
faq.answer1: A QR code (Quick Response Code) is a smart, two-dimensional barcode that can store various types of information, such as website links, text, or contact details. It can be easily captured and deciphered using a smartphone or a dedicated scanner.
faq.question2: How do I create a QR code?
faq.answer2: With qrcodly.de, you can create your custom QR code in no time: simply enter the desired content and download your freshly generated code directly. Quick and straightforward!
faq.question3: What is the difference between static and dynamic QR codes?
faq.answer3: Static QR codes contain fixed information that cannot be changed after creation. Dynamic QR codes, on the other hand, offer maximum flexibility: you can adjust the linked content at any time after creation and also benefit from scan statistics, with detailed analytics on the Pro plan.
faq.answer4: Yes. Static and dynamic QR codes are free, as many as you like, with unlimited scans. Pro adds detailed analytics, custom domains, API access, larger bulk imports and PDF pages.
faq.question5: How long is a QR code valid?
faq.answer5: Static QR codes do not expire and remain permanently valid as long as the linked content is accessible online. Dynamic QR codes remain active as long as they are managed in our system and no specific restrictions apply from the provider.
faq.question6: What are the benefits of dynamic QR codes?
faq.answer6: Dynamic QR codes can be updated at any time, even after printing. They also come with scan statistics: totals and the top country and device on every plan, and the full breakdown by time, country and device with Pro.
faq.question7: Do I need a special app to scan QR codes?
faq.answer7: No, in most cases, it's not necessary! The integrated camera function of modern smartphones can now directly recognize QR codes and open the embedded content – no additional app required.
faq.question8: Which statistics are collected for dynamic QR codes?
faq.answer8: When you enable statistics, each scan of your dynamic QR code records and analyzes information such as the number of scans, visitors, devices used, countries, browsers, and operating systems. The free plan shows totals, the last 7 days and the top country and device; Pro unlocks the full breakdown.
faq.question9: Can I personalize a QR code with my logo?
faq.answer9: Yes, with qrcodly.de, you can design your QR codes exactly to your liking: integrate your logo and use your brand colors without affecting scanability. This way, your codes remain unique and professional!
faq.question10: Do QR codes also work in print?
faq.answer10: Absolutely! QR codes are specifically optimized for printing and work reliably on various materials, as long as they remain clear and undamaged. Ensure good print quality, and your codes will be ready for use anywhere!
faq.answer11: QRcodly's core infrastructure runs on servers in Germany. We use Clerk for sign-in, Stripe for payments, Amazon SES to send our product news and Sentry and PostHog to find errors and improve the product. Your data is not sold or used for third-party advertising. If you have an account, we occasionally send you product news by email. You can turn this off at any time in the settings or via the link in every email.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What's the difference between static and dynamic QR codes?
faq.a1: Static codes encode data directly — they can't be edited or tracked after creation. Dynamic codes use a short redirect URL, so you can change the destination and track scans anytime.
faq.q2: Can I create QR codes in bulk?
faq.a2: Yes. Upload a CSV file to create several codes at once: up to 10 rows per import on Free, 50 with Pro. A saved template gives every code in the batch the same design.
faq.q3: How do I save a QR code design as a template?
faq.a3: Customize your QR code (colors, logo, style), then save it as a template. Next time, select your template and only change the content — your design is applied automatically.
faq.q4: Will my logo stop the code from scanning?
faq.a4: Usually not. QRcodly creates every code with error correction level Q, which can restore roughly a quarter of the pattern — enough for a logo in the centre. Test the code at its final print size before a large run.
faq.q5: Can I use QR codes offline without internet?
faq.a5: WiFi, vCard, and Text QR codes work fully offline — the data is encoded in the code itself. URL-based codes require internet to open the linked page after scanning.
faq.q6: How do I integrate QR code generation into my own app?
faq.a6: With Pro, create an API key in the dashboard and use the QRcodly REST API to create, style and manage QR codes programmatically. The API documentation lists every endpoint.

general.a1: A QR code (Quick Response Code) is a smart, two-dimensional barcode that can store various types of information, such as website links, text, or contact details. It can be easily captured and deciphered using a smartphone or a dedicated scanner.
general.q2: How do I create a QR code?
general.a2: With QRcodly, you can create your custom QR code in no time: simply enter the desired content and download your freshly generated code directly. Quick and straightforward!
general.q3: Do I need a special app to scan QR codes?
general.a3: No, in most cases, it's not necessary! The integrated camera function of modern smartphones can now directly recognize QR codes and open the embedded content — no additional app required.
general.q4: Do QR codes also work in print?
general.a4: Absolutely! QR codes are specifically optimized for printing and work reliably on various materials, as long as they remain clear and undamaged. Ensure good print quality, and your codes will be ready for use anywhere!
general.a5: QRcodly's core infrastructure runs on servers in Germany. We use Clerk for sign-in, Stripe for payments, Amazon SES to send our product news and Sentry and PostHog to find errors and improve the product. Your data is not sold or used for third-party advertising. If you have an account, we occasionally send you product news by email. You can turn this off at any time in the settings or via the link in every email.
general.a6: Yes! QRcodly is fully open source and available on GitHub. You can inspect the code, contribute, or even self-host your own instance.
general.q7: Can I use QRcodly for commercial purposes?
general.a7: Absolutely. QRcodly is free for both personal and commercial use. Create QR codes for your business, marketing campaigns, product packaging, or any other commercial application.

qrCodes.q1: Is the QR code generator free?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is this QR code scanner free?
faq.a1: Yes. The online QR code reader is completely free, needs no account and has no scan limit.
faq.q2: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq.a2: No. The image is decoded directly in your browser. Nothing is sent to QRcodly or to third parties, and nothing is stored.
faq.q3: Which file formats can I scan?
faq.a3: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP and SVG, as well as screenshots pasted from the clipboard. PDFs are not supported – take a screenshot of the code instead.
faq.q4: Why is my QR code not detected?
faq.a4: Usually the image is blurry, too small or cut off, the code has too little light space around it, or the colors have too little contrast. Try a sharper, larger image or a screenshot without surrounding clutter.
faq.q5: Can I scan a QR code with my camera?
faq.a5: Yes. Click "Scan with camera" and allow camera access. The live image is analyzed on your device only, and the camera turns off as soon as a code is detected or you leave the page.
faq.q6: Is it safe to open a link from a QR code?
faq.a6: A link is only as safe as the website behind it. The scanner shows you the full URL and the domain before you open anything. Be careful with shortened links and unknown domains, and never enter passwords or payment details on a page you reached through an unexpected code.
faq.q7: How do I read a QR code on my PC without an app?
faq.a7: Take a screenshot of the code or save the image, then drop it into the scanner above or paste it with Ctrl+V. The content appears right away – no app, no extension, no account needed.
